Definition: of Hebrew origin (probably H3723 and H5151); Capernaum (i.e. Caphanachum), a place in Palestine:--Capernaum.
BiblicalUsage: Capernaum is the town by the Sea of Galilee that became Jesus' own city. He came and dwelt there after leaving Nazareth, taught in its synagogue, healed the centurion's servant there, and pronounced woe upon it because it was exalted to heaven and would be brought down to hell.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Capernaum is the sobering side of privilege: the town that heard the most and saw the most was judged the hardest, and nearness to the truth is no substitute for receiving it.
